stance_rationale: Phase A design documents are coherent enough to critique, but the package has no executable alpha artifact, no alpha_scores.parquet, no IC/AUC OOS diagnostics, no challenge_note, and no AX-008 triangulation. A regime-feature-only label cannot waive QEPM evidence requirements when the feature is intended to enter DPL-RC production selection.

rank_ic.evidence: alpha_package_draft.json marks rank_ic as to-be-measured at Forge, not measured.

icir.evidence: icir is declared n/a because SEFRS is not a stock-level alpha source.

harvey_t.evidence: harvey_t_count is 0 marker; no Harvey-Liu-Zhu t-stat result.

sub_stability.evidence: Subperiod stability is deferred to Stage 3 walk-forward.

dsr.evidence: No DSR calculation or input return series exists.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Required qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260518_001/alpha_scores.parquet is absent; sefrs_features.parquet is also TBD. Date x Ticker x score multi-sig-date structure cannot be verified.

RF-A2.evidence: No composite versus best single factor comparison.

RF-A4.evidence: Sector-neutral ICIR is not applicable to a market-level regime feature, but no stock-level spillover test exists.

RF-A5.evidence: No top-decile liquidity test or realized universe.

RF-A6.evidence: Multiple labels/models/gates are proposed, but no completed multi-testing adjustment, Harvey t-stat, or DSR.

RF-A7.evidence: No alpha_scores.parquet or feature time series artifact.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern found; signed ETF multipliers are economically specified rather than Factor DB sign flips.
No Usable_Date field or generated artifact exists; t-1/t+2 publish timing is unresolved for shares-based features.
Factor DB is not used; external ETF data collector is proposed instead.
m4/regime interactions are specified as t-1, but no code or lineage proves lagged overlay behavior.
No financial statement fields are used in SEFRS.

critical_concerns.description: Mandatory time-series alpha validation is impossible: alpha_scores.parquet is absent, sefrs_features.parquet is TBD, and the qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260518_001 directory is missing. This fails the Date x Ticker x score requirement and cannot clear the Iter 4 single-snapshot failure mode.

The package substitutes Phase A design intent for measured evidence: rank IC, ICIR, Harvey t, DSR, monotonicity, subperiod stability, AUC uplift, and Brier calibration are all deferred to Forge. That leaves no basis for approving an alpha-facing production candidate.

The claim that SEFRS is only a regime feature is the weakest exemption: it is still intended to alter DPL-RC p_bad_1715 classifier features from 80 to 88 and affect portfolio decisions. The AX-007 multi-sleeve exception is asserted but not instantiated with OOS integration artifacts.

Lockbox and dating are not clean. Current system time is 2026-05-17, but package and artifact dates are 2026-05-18, while the package claims paper-trade access is forbidden from 2026-05-01 onward and still uses 2026-05-17 KR media as empirical support.

Event-time logic is internally inconsistent: the protocol says t data is usable from t+2 09:00, but several features use shares/NAV/TVA/premium at t-1 and the feasibility note says t+1 lag is sufficient. Without a formal decision timestamp and Usable_Date column, PIT safety is a design assertion.

User-requested verification artifacts are missing: weights.csv, covariance.parquet, alpha_scores.parquet, final alpha_package.json, factor_engine_proposal.R, challenge_note, and artifact_lineage are absent. AX-008 triangulation cannot pass with only alpha draft plus protocols.

The literature review cites plausible ETF-flow mechanisms, but the KR-specific contrarian claim relies heavily on 2026 media examples and has no pre-registered pre-lockbox OOS test. This is mechanism import plus anecdotal KR support, not yet KR market verification.

supporting_arguments: Phase A docs exist in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260518_001 and contain explicit formulas, lag tables, and PIT audit protocols.
The package correctly admits that current infrastructure lacks ETF daily shares/NAV/AUM/TVA data and that a new collector is required.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a regime feature intended for DPL-RC production may bypass alpha_package time-series alpha artifact requirements.
Whether 2026-05-17 empirical media examples contaminate the declared 2026-05-01 onward paper-trade/lockbox boundary.
Whether t-1 shares/AUM features are usable at the intended monthly rebalance timestamp under SEIBro publish timing.
Whether the 80-to-88 DPL-RC feature uplift survives purged walk-forward OOS with unchanged baseline features.
Whether the absent weights/covariance artifacts are out of scope for alpha critique or a task-level package completeness failure.
weakest_assumption: That labeling SEFRS as regime_feature_only_NOT_alpha_sleeve makes missing alpha_scores, IC/DSR/Harvey diagnostics, lockbox controls, and DPL-RC integration evidence acceptable.
rebuttal_required: Produce actual sefrs_features.parquet or alpha_scores.parquet with multi-date schema and publish-time metadata.
Report RF-A1 through RF-A7 with realized metrics, not Forge-stage placeholders.
Provide purged walk-forward AUC/Brier/feature-importance results for DPL-RC 80 versus 88 features.
Resolve current-date versus as_of_date and prove no post-2026-05-01 evidence influenced design selection.
Provide challenge_note, artifact_lineage, and at least 2-source AX-008 verification.
rationalization_red_flags: Substantive: t+1 lag로 충분 / 안전 margin 충분
Guardrail-only occurrences detected: 영향 미미 / 관행적 허용 / 보수적이면 괜찮다 / 대부분 결과 동일 / 이미 반영되어 있었을 것 / 백테스트 기간이 충분히 길어서 상쇄

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: This is a design dossier, not an alpha package that can be approved. The external critic should force empirical artifact production before any APPROVE_CONDITIONAL stance.

alpha_specific_questions: Can SEFRS maintain t_NW > 2.95 or equivalent corrected evidence in the DPL-RC fund-of-fund environment after multi-testing?
Does every SEIBro-derived feature carry source_publish_timestamp and Usable_Date <= sig_date under t+2 availability?
If AX-005/AX-007 avoidance depends on regime-feature-only classification, where is the OOS evidence that the DPL-RC integration exception is sufficient rather than merely necessary?
